name: Spondylolysis and Spondylolisthesis
summary: Spondylolysis is a defect or stress injury (a crack or break) in the pars interarticularis, the small bridge of bone joining the upper and lower facet joints of a lumbar vertebra. It is a common cause of back pain in young athletes who repeatedly extend and rotate the spine, for example in gymnastics, cricket fast bowling, diving and weightlifting.

blocks.text: **Spondylolysis** is a defect or stress injury (a crack or break) in the **pars interarticularis**, the small bridge of bone joining the upper and lower facet joints of a lumbar vertebra. It is a common cause of back pain in young athletes who repeatedly extend and rotate the spine, for example in gymnastics, cricket fast bowling, diving and weightlifting [Ref - to verify].
**Spondylolisthesis** means one vertebra has slipped forward over the one below. The two main types are:

rows: Mostly L5 on S1; adolescents and young adults
Age-related facet and disc change, no pars defect
Mostly L4 on L5; older adults, more common in women [Ref - to verify]

blocks.text: Rarer types exist (congenital, traumatic, pathological from tumour or disease). The size of the slip is graded by doctors from X-ray using the **Meyerding** **grade**: Grade I is up to 25% of the vertebral width, II is 25 to 50%, III is 50 to 75%, IV is 75 to 100%, and V is beyond 100% (spondyloptosis) [Ref - to verify].
A slip or pars defect on imaging does not always cause pain [Ref - to verify]. Treatment depends on symptoms, nerve signs and stability, not on the image alone.

rows: Low back pain on one or both sides, worse with extension and rotation (arching, landing, bowling), eased by rest; usually no leg symptoms
Back pain, tight hamstrings, sometimes a stiff short-stride gait; leg symptoms are possible if the slip compresses a root
Back pain with standing and walking; leg pain or heaviness (neurogenic claudication, see Ch 4) eased by sitting or flexion; or radicular pain

sections.title: G. RED FLAGS AND URGENT CONDITIONS

Stop; hospital the same day (Vol 4 Ch 3)
Child or adolescent with severe pain, visible deformity or gait change
Refer to spine specialist; avoid loading

blocks.text: **Defer:** manipulation or end-range extension loading until imaging and medical review are available when a high-grade slip or rapid change is suspected.

sections.title: H. Working diagnosis and decision pathway

items: Any emergency or urgent flag? **Yes:** act as in Section G.
Adolescent or young athlete with extension-related low back pain and a suggestive test? **Yes:** working diagnosis is possible spondylolysis. Restrict provocative activity and refer for imaging.
Older adult with back pain and walking-related leg symptoms? **Yes:** consider degenerative spondylolisthesis with stenosis (Ch 4).
No nerve signs, stable, mild to moderate pain? **Yes:** start conservative care.
Persistent disabling symptoms, progressive slip or neurological deficit? **Yes:** surgical opinion through a doctor.

blocks.text: **Preferred starting choice:** active rehabilitation and load management, not forceful lumbar manual techniques. Avoid high-velocity manipulation and strong extension mobilization at the slipped level because stability is the concern and benefit is unproven [Ref - to verify].

sections.title: J. Exercise prescription (example starting plan, not universal)

rows: Lying with knees bent, gently tighten the lower abdomen without holding the breath
Lying, lower opposite arm and leg while keeping the back still
Support on elbow and knees, lift hips
Lying, strap around the foot, straighten the leg

blocks.text: **Avoid early:** repeated end-range extension, heavy loaded extension and twisting, and for young athletes the sport activity that provokes pain until reviewed.

**Young athletes:** activity restriction and bracing in some cases are used for suspected active stress injuries, but the optimal approach and the benefit of bracing are debated [Ref - to verify]. Return to sport is graded by pain, function and imaging advice from the medical team. No fixed number of weeks is given here.

rows: Used selectively in young patients with stress injury

blocks.text: **Case:** A 15-year-old fast bowler has 6 weeks of low back pain that is worse when bowling and arching. Rest eases it. No leg symptoms, normal reflexes, tight hamstrings. Single-leg extension on the right reproduces his pain.

**Working diagnosis:** suspected right-sided pars stress injury (spondylolysis). **Plan:** stop bowling and other provoking sport, refer for medical imaging, begin pain-free trunk and hip exercises, review with the doctor's findings.
**Questions and answers**

items: Why is a positive stork test not enough to confirm spondylolysis? Its accuracy is low and other structures can also reproduce the pain, so imaging is needed for confirmation.
Why avoid repeated extension exercises early? They load the area that may be injured and could delay healing.
Why check hamstrings? Tight hamstrings are common in slips and affect pelvic posture and loading.
A 62-year-old with a slip also has leg heaviness on walking. Which chapter do you add? Stenosis (Ch 4), because the leg symptoms point to neurogenic claudication.

The patient asks whether the slipped bone will get worse. What do you say? Most slips stay stable in adults, but this cannot be promised. Explain the monitoring plan and when to report new symptoms [Ref - to verify].
**Initial approach:** education, load management and active trunk and hip rehabilitation.
**Justifying findings:** extension-related pain, suggestive tests, no nerve loss or flags.
**Priority:** protect healing in young athletes; build trunk control in adults.
**Manual therapy:** minor adjunct; avoid forceful lumbar techniques.
**Exercise:** bracing, dead bug, side plank, bridge, stretches.
**Modalities:** optional comfort.
**Tell the patient:** the finding is common and usually manageable; report nerve symptoms immediately.
**Avoid:** repeated end-range extension, manipulation at the slipped level, ignoring CES symptoms.
**Measure:** pain, function, trunk endurance, neurology.
**If no improvement:** spine specialist.
**Referral triggers:** Section G.
**Discharge:** pain controlled, strength restored, return to sport or work safely.

blocks.text: **Assumptions:** low-grade, stable, no neurological deficit.

items: **Can be tested:** whether physiotherapy rehabilitation improves pain and function; whether bracing speeds healing in young athletes.
**Hypotheses:** that trunk stabilisation protects the slipped segment.
**Future questions:** best return-to-sport timing, and which slips progress.

blocks.text: Evidence not graded until references are verified.

sections.A: Spondylolysis mein vertebra ke ek patle hisse (pars) mein crack ya stress injury hoti hai. Spondylolisthesis mein ek vertebra neeche wale par aage khisak jata hai.
sections.B: Naujawan khiladi: kamar ko peeche jhukane ya ghumane par dard, aaraam se behtar. Bare umar mein: kamar dard, kabhi taang mein symptoms.
sections.C: Kaun sa khel ya baar baar movement, training ka load haal mein barha ya nahi, aur kya peeche jhukne se dard aata hai.
sections.D: Posture aur chaal dekhein, vertebrae par ungli se step dhoondein (na mile to bhi khisakna ho sakta hai), aur neuro exam.
sections.E: Koi clinical test pars ka crack confirm nahi karta; diagnosis doctor imaging se karta hai. Tests sirf shak ko mazboot karte hain.
sections.F: Aam kamar dard, facet joint ka dard aur doosri wajahein table mein hain.
sections.G: Saddle sunn-pan, peshab ya pakhane ki tabdeeli, barhti kamzori ya foot drop: foran referral.
sections.H: Naujawan khiladi ko peeche jhukne par dard aur test positive ho to imaging ke liye doctor ke paas bhejein, aur us dauraan load kam karein.
sections.I: Hip aur thoracic mobilisation, aur hamstring aur hip flexor stretching kamar ka load kam karte hain.
sections.J: Abdominal bracing, dead bug, side plank aur dheere dheere taaqat aur khel ki taraf wapsi.
sections.K: Garmi aur TENS optional. Brace sirf doctor ki hidayat par.
sections.L: Samjhayein ke is finding ka matlab kya hai aur kya nahi. Pehle dard wali activities kam, phir trunk aur hip ki rehab, phir khel par wapsi.
sections.M: Dard, extension tolerance, trunk endurance, neuro status aur khel ka load track karein. Naya nerve sign aaye to dobara refer.
sections.N: 15 saal ka fast bowler bowling ke waqt kamar dard mehsoos karta hai. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
